description: This file contains a function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of raw aggregate records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. The function groups data by agent and a secondary dimension (environment or cost_category), fills in missing categories with zero values, and sorts the agents and categories as specified.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, aggregating costs per agent and category, and ensuring consistent categories across all agents with optional sorting.
